Une mobilisation solidaire dans trois wi: A solidarity mobilization in three wilayas
Ooredoo a annoncé le lancement d’une cam: Ooredoo announced the launch of a blood donation campaign in collaboration with the National Blood Agency (ANS). The operation, scheduled for this Tuesday, July 14, 2026, will take place at the operator's headquarters in Algiers, Oran and Constantine. This initiative is part of an approach to social responsibility and the promotion of public health.
L’Agence Nationale du Sang (ANS) et Oore: The National Blood Agency (ANS) and Ooredoo are calling on company employees to participate massively in this collection. Officials from the three wilayas concerned will supervise the smooth running of the operation, which aims to strengthen the blood stocks available for the country's hospitals and health centers.
L’opération de don de sang s’accompagne: The blood donation operation is accompanied by photographic coverage, the photos of which are attached to the press release. These images illustrate the commitment of the participants and the logistics put in place to guarantee the safety and efficiency of the collection.
Ooredoo invite les médias à relayer cett: Ooredoo invites the media to relay this initiative to the general public, in order to encourage other companies to engage in similar actions of national solidarity.
Objectif : Renforcer les stocks de sang: Objective: Strengthen blood stocks for hospitals
Moyen de diffusion : Communiqué de press: Means of distribution: Press release + attached photos
